fishfight.unique.horsepower.desc: Clearly a horse. Its hits send the foe flying
fishfight.unique.tofu_mental.desc: Lots of HP, but may die of shock when hit. Sometimes even when caught
fishfight.fishing.sunfish_shock: The moment you landed it, %s died of shock...
fishfight.battle.homerun: %s got knocked out of the park!
fishfight.tooltip.hint_practice: Sneak + right-click to spar with a wild fish

fishfight.help.kit: /fishfight kit - (OP) get a set of fun fish for filming
fishfight.help.settings: /fishfight settings - (OP) minigame chance, slow motion, commentary...
fishfight.announcer.start.0: And we're off! A fight between fish that makes no sense at all!
fishfight.announcer.start.1: Even I, the commentator, don't understand the rules!
fishfight.announcer.start.2: Both competitors are on dry land! Why?!
fishfight.announcer.start.3: Today's venue: very clearly not water!
fishfight.announcer.seahorse.0: Uh... that's a horse. That is clearly a horse.
fishfight.announcer.seahorse.1: We were promised a seahorse. That's just a horse!
fishfight.announcer.sunfish.0: A sunfish! It already looks like it's about to die!
fishfight.announcer.sunfish.1: Please, no loud noises near the sunfish!
fishfight.announcer.crit.0: What a hit! That's no ordinary fish!
fishfight.announcer.crit.1: That wasn't a fin, that was pure soul!
fishfight.announcer.crit.2: Critical! The crowd (probably none) is on its feet!
fishfight.announcer.arms.0: ARMS?! Did that thing just grow ARMS?!
fishfight.announcer.arms.1: It just skipped a few hundred million years of evolution!
fishfight.announcer.arms.2: It has abandoned its fins! It means business!
fishfight.announcer.legs.0: LEGS! It's officially a land animal now!
fishfight.announcer.seahorse_legs.0: From THERE?! Legs grow from THERE?!
fishfight.announcer.seahorse_legs.1: Turns out its own legs were just decoration!
fishfight.announcer.shark.0: The shark... the shark became a MAN!!
fishfight.announcer.shark.1: Absolutely ripped! And it brought its own swim trunks!
fishfight.announcer.ko.1: It's flying! That's out of the arena!
fishfight.announcer.mola_death.1: Its mental fortitude was made of tofu!
fishfight.announcer.reset.0: A standoff! The referee (me) steps in!
fishfight.tooltip.unidentified: Not identified yet (hold it to roll stats)

fishfight.skill.leg_sprout.desc: Grows legs after flopping on land: walks and fights properly
fishfight.skill.giantize.desc: Grows huge below 30% HP: attack up
fishfight.skill.regenerate.desc: Heals a lot once below 35% HP
fishfight.skill.discharge.desc: Shocks a nearby foe and stuns it
fishfight.skill.charge.desc: Dashes at a distant foe for big damage
fishfight.skill.water_gun.desc: Shoots water at a distant foe
fishfight.skill.puff_up.desc: Puffs up when hit: defense x2 for a while
fishfight.skill.endure.desc: Survives a fatal hit once with 1 HP
fishfight.battle.skill.arm_sprout: WHAT?! %s suddenly sprouted buff ARMS!! (attack up)
fishfight.battle.skill.leg_sprout: %s grew LEGS! No more flopping around!
fishfight.battle.skill.leg_sprout_seahor: New legs grew out of %s's underside?! (it will not use its own)
